title: A Survey of Mathematical Reasoning in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Model: Benchmark, Method & Challenges
best_for_zh: 设计或评测含图像、图形等非纯文本数学推理任务的读者。
one_line: A Findings ACL 2025 survey of multimodal mathematical reasoning benchmarks, methods, and challenges.
系统整理多模态大模型数学推理的基准、方法与挑战。
why: It separates failures in multimodal mathematical reasoning into evaluation, methodology, and challenge dimensions.
inclusion_reason: A peer-reviewed survey organizing multimodal mathematical reasoning around benchmarks, methods, and open challenges.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal mathematical reasoning requires a model to work with mathematical content that may include more than text. The authors note that mathematical reasoning is important from education to scientific work and survey how multimodal large language models are being used for it. This Findings ACL 2025 paper reviews benchmarks, methods, and challenges rather than proposing a new model or benchmark.

The problem is broader than obtaining a final numerical answer. A system must interpret the supplied modality and connect it to the mathematical task before a reasoning result can be meaningful. This survey is useful for deciding whether a paper studies perception, mathematical inference, or their combination; it does not supply one new dataset or a common experimental solution.

多模态数学推理要求模型处理不只含文本的数学内容。作者指出，数学推理从教育解题到科学研究都很重要，因此系统考察多模态大语言模型如何承担这类任务。论文发表于 Findings ACL 2025，整理基准、方法与挑战，而不提出新的模型或基准。

问题不止是得到一个数值答案。系统要先解释输入模态，再把它连接到数学任务，推理结果才有意义。本文有助于判断一篇工作研究的是感知、数学推断，还是两者结合；它不提供统一实验解法。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The survey's organizing idea is three-dimensional: benchmarks, methodologies, and challenges. It uses that structure to connect multimodal mathematical reasoning pipelines with the roles played by language models and multimodal language models. A reader can use the map to ask whether a reported result is limited by the task set, by the method, or by an unresolved difficulty in the setting.

These dimensions should be read together rather than as interchangeable labels. A benchmark specifies an evaluation surface, a methodology specifies an intervention, and a challenge identifies a source of uncertainty or failure. The framework helps a reader avoid crediting a model change for an effect that may instead follow from the selected input modality or task construction.

综述以三个维度组织内容：基准、方法和挑战。它借此连接多模态数学推理流程，以及语言模型和多模态语言模型在其中承担的角色。读者可用这张地图判断：一个结果的限制来自任务集合、方法本身，还是该设置尚未解决的困难。

三者不能互换：基准规定评测面，方法规定干预，挑战指出不确定性或失败来源。把它们合起来读，可避免把某一模型变化的效果误归因，而忽略输入模态或任务构造的影响。

title: Method
方法
html:
Its method is a review of more than 200 studies published since 2021, according to the official abstract. The inputs are published studies on Math-LLMs and multimodal settings; the outputs are a field overview, a discussion of multimodal reasoning pipelines, and five major challenges. It does not provide a common training protocol, verifier, reward, or new artifact, so those properties remain study-specific.

For each cited primary work, record the input modalities, mathematical objective, model role, benchmark, and scoring rule. This produces a compact record that matches the survey's pipeline-oriented account. It also keeps the survey's field synthesis separate from implementation details such as data preprocessing, prompting, and component interfaces, which are not standardized across the reviewed studies.

根据官方摘要，论文回顾了 2021 年以来发表的 200 多项研究。输入是 Math-LLM 与多模态设置的已发表工作；输出是领域概览、多模态推理流程讨论和五项主要挑战。它没有提供统一训练协议、验证器、奖励或新资源，这些属性仍由各项原始研究决定。

对每篇原始工作，可记录输入模态、数学目标、模型角色、基准和评分规则。这个简表对应本文的流程视角，也能把领域综合与实现细节分开；预处理、提示和组件接口在被综述研究中并不统一。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's support comes from its stated coverage of over 200 studies and its explicit benchmark–method–challenge framework. The official abstract says it examines state-of-the-art Math-LLM developments with emphasis on multimodal settings. This supports its value as a landscape summary, not as a single controlled experiment establishing a universal best approach.

Its evidence is therefore evidence about reported practices, categories, and open difficulties in the literature. It should not be interpreted as a direct head-to-head comparison between every model or modality. When a result affects a design decision, consult the original experiment to determine what input information was available and which stage of the pipeline its metric actually evaluates.

论文的支撑来自其对 200 多项研究的覆盖，以及明确的“基准—方法—挑战”框架。官方摘要说明它考察了 Math-LLM 的最新发展，并特别关注多模态设置。这证明它适合作为领域全景总结，而不是一项能确定通用最优方法的单一受控实验。

因此它的证据针对文献中的实践、类别和未解困难，而不是所有模型、模态之间的直接对比。某个结果会影响设计决策时，应查原始实验，确认输入信息以及指标实际评测了流程中的哪一环。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The authors describe this as the first comprehensive analysis of mathematical reasoning in the era of multimodal large language models. The contribution is a synthesis spanning benchmarks, methods, pipelines, and five stated challenges, rather than a newly trained system. Its value is strongest when comparing research designs that otherwise mix perception, representation, and mathematical inference.

The new value is an integrated vocabulary for a field whose papers can otherwise appear comparable merely because they contain mathematics and multiple modalities. It clarifies that changing an image representation, a reasoning procedure, and an answer evaluator are different interventions. Readers can use this distinction to state more precisely what a new system contributes and what remains inherited from its setting.

作者将其描述为首篇系统分析多模态大语言模型时代数学推理的综合综述。贡献在于综合基准、方法、流程和五项明确挑战，而不是训练一个新系统。当不同研究把感知、表示和数学推断混在一起时，这一框架尤其有助于做清晰比较。

它提供的是整合词汇：含数学和多模态并不意味着论文可直接比较。改变图像表示、推理过程和答案评测是不同干预。读者可据此更准确说明一个新系统改变了什么，哪些条件仍继承自既有设置。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The underlying literature spans different models, modalities, tasks, and benchmark conventions, so individual results may not be directly comparable. In a multimodal task, an error can arise before symbolic or numerical reasoning begins, making a final wrong answer hard to attribute to one component. The survey names major challenges but does not itself establish a shared measurement protocol for resolving them.

Do not infer a mathematical-reasoning failure from answer accuracy alone when the system also has to interpret non-textual input. Conversely, a correct answer does not identify which component carried the relevant information. The survey highlights these attribution difficulties; primary papers must provide the task construction and analysis needed to decide whether a comparison isolates the intended capability.

底层研究使用不同模型、模态、任务和基准约定，因此单项结果未必能直接比较。在多模态任务中，错误可能发生在符号或数值推理开始之前，导致最终错误难以归因到单一组件。论文指出主要挑战，但没有自行建立一套统一的测量协议来解决它们。

当系统还需解释非文本输入时，不能只用最终正确率推断数学推理失败；正确答案也不能说明哪个组件提供了关键信息。本文指出这种归因困难，原始论文需给出任务构造和分析，才能判断比较是否隔离了目标能力。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this survey when building a reading list or an evaluation plan for a mathematical task with visual or other non-textual inputs. Its three dimensions help specify what should be compared: benchmark choice, methodological intervention, and the challenge being targeted. It is also useful for preventing a single answer-accuracy number from hiding which stage of a multimodal pipeline failed.

Before implementing a system, turn the three dimensions into an evaluation checklist: specify the input modality, mathematical objective, benchmark, method change, and anticipated failure point. That makes a proposed comparison interpretable. The survey is an orientation and design aid, while the cited primary studies remain the sources for concrete architectures, training choices, and measured outcomes.

当你要为含视觉或其他非文本输入的数学任务建立阅读清单或评测计划时，可使用这篇综述。它的三个维度能明确比较对象：选了什么基准、采用何种方法、试图解决哪项困难。它也能避免用一个最终正确率掩盖多模态流程中究竟哪一步失败。

实现前可把三维框架写成清单：输入模态、数学目标、基准、方法变化与预期失败点。这样比较才可解释。本文适合做方向与设计参考，具体架构、训练选择和结果仍应以原始研究为准。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Start with the three dimensions, then read the discussion of multimodal reasoning pipelines before the five challenges. While reading a primary paper, write down the input modalities, the mathematical task, the benchmark, and the evaluation rule. That compact record makes later comparisons much more reliable.

Also note which pipeline stage a paper claims to improve and whether its evaluation can distinguish that stage from the others. Compare only papers with sufficiently similar inputs and task requirements before ranking their results. This habit turns the survey's overview into a practical reading workflow and prevents a visually rich task from being treated as an ordinary text-only mathematics benchmark.

建议先掌握三个组织维度，再读多模态推理流程，最后看五项挑战。阅读任一原始论文时，记录输入模态、数学任务、基准和评测规则。这份简短记录能让后续比较更可靠。

还要记录论文声称改善流程的哪一阶段，以及评测能否将该阶段与其他阶段区分开。只在输入和任务要求足够相似时比较结果。这会把综述概览变成实用阅读流程，避免把视觉丰富任务当成普通文本数学基准。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Yibo Yan, Jiamin Su, Jianxiang He, Fangteng Fu, Xu Zheng, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Kun Wang, Shen Wang, Qingsong Wen, and Xuming Hu. 2025. A Survey of Mathematical Reasoning in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Model: Benchmark, Method & Challenges. Findings of ACL 2025, pages 11798–11827. https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.614/

Use the ACL Anthology record as the authoritative source for bibliographic metadata and the official paper. Cite this survey for its benchmark–method–challenge synthesis and its account of the reviewed field. When discussing a particular dataset, multimodal pipeline, model result, or evaluation protocol, cite the corresponding primary study as well, because this paper does not newly establish those empirical details.

Yibo Yan、Jiamin Su、Jianxiang He 等。2025。《A Survey of Mathematical Reasoning in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Model: Benchmark, Method & Challenges》。Findings of ACL 2025，11798–11827 页。https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.614/

书目信息和官方论文应以 ACL Anthology 为准。本文可用于引用其“基准—方法—挑战”的领域综合；讨论某个数据集、流程、模型结果或评测协议时，也应引用对应原始研究，因为这些实证细节并非本文新建立。
